title: Paclitaxel, carboplatin AUC 6 and bevacizumab
schedule_label: Up to 6 combination cycles, then bevacizumab alone.
schedule_summary: After surgery, the first cycle contains paclitaxel and carboplatin. Bevacizumab starts from cycle 2 if the wound has healed and the team considers it safe. Paclitaxel, carboplatin AUC 6 and bevacizumab 15 mg/kg on day 1 every three weeks. Chemotherapy is given for up to six cycles. Bevacizumab alone every three weeks, up to 15 months (22 cycles) across treatment, or until progression or unacceptable side effects.
purpose: Control the cancer, relieve symptoms and delay progression.
indication_text: First-line treatment of FIGO stage IIIB, IIIC or IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer.
administration_text: Intravenous treatment in the oncology day unit. Up to 6 combination cycles, then bevacizumab alone.
monitoring_summary: Blood counts and organ function are reviewed with symptoms and fitness for treatment.
review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

agents.name: Paclitaxel
agents.explanation: It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected.
agents.mechanism: It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected.
agents.watch: Report numbness and tell the nurse immediately if you flush or wheeze during treatment.
visual: It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected.

agents.name: Carboplatin
agents.explanation: It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
agents.mechanism: It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
agents.watch: Report fever, bleeding, hearing changes or an infusion reaction.
visual: It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.

agents.name: Bevacizumab
agents.explanation: It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
agents.mechanism: It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
visual: It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
agents.watch: Call urgently for severe abdominal pain, significant bleeding, a new severe headache or sudden weakness.

common_effects.title: Between visits
common_effects.text: Fatigue, taste changes and nausea can affect meals and daily activities. Take the prescribed anti-sickness medicines and call if you cannot drink.

common_effects.title: Numbness or tingling
common_effects.text: Tell the team before your next infusion if tingling, numbness or loss of balance affects walking or using your hands.

serious_effects.title: Blood pressure · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: Blood pressure can rise without symptoms. Keep your checks. Call urgently for a severe headache or vision changes.

serious_effects.title: Bowel injury · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: Call urgently for severe new tummy pain, swelling or fever. A tear or abnormal connection needs immediate care.

serious_effects.title: Protein in urine · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: A urine test can find protein before symptoms. Report new swelling or frothy urine.

serious_effects.title: Bleeding and healing · Bevacizumab
serious_effects.text: Report wounds that reopen. Heavy bleeding, coughing blood or sudden breathlessness need urgent help.

serious_effects.title: Infection and low counts · Chemotherapy
serious_effects.text: Call the unit immediately for fever, chills, heavy bleeding or suddenly feeling unwell.

serious_effects.title: Numb hands or feet · Paclitaxel
serious_effects.text: Report tingling, difficulty fastening buttons or a change in balance before your next dose.

serious_effects.title: Hair loss · Paclitaxel
serious_effects.text: Discuss headwear or scalp cooling with the team before the first infusion.

serious_effects.title: Hearing · Carboplatin
serious_effects.text: Report ringing in your ears or a change in hearing.

Call oncology urgently for fever, chills, new breathlessness or severe diarrhoea. Severe abdominal pain or unexpected bleeding also needs urgent review.

support.title: Paclitaxel
support.text: Confirm which steroid premedicines to take before paclitaxel. Tell the nurse immediately about flushing, wheeze or throat tightness.

support.title: Carboplatin
support.text: Kidney function helps determine carboplatin dosing. Report previous platinum allergy.

support.title: Bevacizumab
support.text: Your team checks blood pressure, urine protein and healing. Report recent procedures, bleeding or new abdominal pain.

teachback: Which days are infusion days, and which symptoms mean you should call urgently?
consent_support: Discuss the expected benefit, side effects, fertility, alternatives and symptom-directed care with the treating clinician. You may ask for more time or change your decision.
safety_note: Call oncology urgently for fever, chills, new breathlessness or severe diarrhoea. Severe abdominal pain or unexpected bleeding also needs urgent review.

evidence.title: GOG-0218
evidence.interpretation: Continuing bevacizumab after chemotherapy delayed progression in the first-line study.
evidence.limitations: The final analysis did not show an overall survival improvement across the whole study population.
